uniform_domain: Every odd N >= 3 over Q(omega_N) embedded in C, with supplied primitive root; includes N=5q^2, q odd, coprime to 5, q=1 mod 241.
exact_scalar_chirp_bank_minimum: (N+1)/2 branches for C_sigma=sum a_s (I-lambda_s P)^-1, fixed natural P, scalar coefficients, no additional diagonal correction.
node_generator: P_r+tau P_(r-1), first legal tau in 0,...,2N; explicit chirp coefficient formula and exact gcd checks.
excluded_claims: No bit-complexity or numerical stability theorem
common_order_rank_argument: Reviewed as an existing project corollary, not claimed new.
